title: quercus gambelii var. gunnisonii
intro: Quercus gambelii var. gunnisonii, commonly known as Gunnison's oak, is a variety of the Gambel oak tree, a deciduous tree native to the mountainous regions of North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Gunnison's oak include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Quercus gambelii var. gunnisonii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
